applied.description: Removed all 43 [[interim-report-*]] workspace-artifact wikilinks (citation_style=wikilink mode): deleted where a real source note was already cited adjacent or the claim rests on the run's own repo/fleet audit (file:line reads, measured exit codes, live D-Bus probes); substituted the interim's own cited source note where it carried the claim (rumqttc PR #1052 note, Event-enum docs note, LWT explainer, backlightc kernel source, feature-request #667/#926 notes, systemdexec + Scrutiny capability matrix). Removed meta-discourse: 'worth stating explicitly' (S7); 'the day someone adds' hypothetical kept (load-bearing).
